text: I. Professional OverviewStomatology is an important branch of the medical field, mainly focusing on the diagnosis, treatment and prevention of oral and maxillofacial diseases. It covers multiple directions such as endodontic diseases, periodontal diseases, prosthodontics, orthodontics and oral and maxillofacial surgery. This major integrates medicine, biology, materials science and engineering technology, aiming to maintain oral health through clinical diagnosis and treatment, preventive health care and other means. At the same time, it involves cross-disciplinary fields such as facial aesthetic restoration and functional reconstruction. It is an applied major with a high degree of combination of theory and practice.Ii. Training ObjectivesCultivate high-quality medical talents with solid medical basic theories, systematic professional knowledge of stomatology and proficient clinical operation skills. Students are required to master the diagnosis, treatment and prevention methods of oral diseases, possess the skills of doctor-patient communication, clinical thinking and scientific research innovation awareness, and be able to engage in oral clinical medical treatment, teaching, scientific research and preventive health care in medical and health institutions, research institutes, educational units, etc. At the same time, they should abide by medical ethics and conduct, and fulfill the mission of oral health services under the "Healthy China" strategy.
